headline: Optical Stochastic Cooling Advances: Fermilab’s IOTA Ring Demonstrates Microbunching and Multi‑Dimensional Cooling
deck: The latest experiments at Fermilab’s IOTA storage ring confirm the theoretical predictions of optical stochastic cooling (OSC), achieving steady‑state microbunching through Optical Stochastic Crystallization and demonstrating significant cooling in all three phase‑space dimensions. These results pave the way for enhanced beam‑damping techniques in future accelerator facilities.
